messages.subject: GBS genotypes from TASSEL to R/qtl
parts:
Hi all,

One of the other users dug out an old thread about how to get GBS genotypes into R/qtl and wrote a PM asking for advice.

It seems he was unaware that TASSEL5 can export R/qtl ready genotypes using the Data -> ABH Genotype option.

Just letting you know.

Cheers,

Stefan
